lead.description: a frequency curve whose logarithmic slope, at the mode, is minus the abscissa divided by a quadratic

self_checks.title: A bag of one hundred
self_checks.prompt: For n = 100, between which values of p, to four decimals, is every draw size a trigonometric integral?

self_checks.title: A one-sided curve
self_checks.prompt: A Type III curve has p = 3 and gamma = 2. What are mu2, the memoir skewness 1/sqrt(p+1), and mu4/mu2^2?
self_checks.answer: mu2 is 1, the memoir skewness is 1/2, and mu4/mu2^2 is 9/2.

self_checks.title: Another one-sided curve
self_checks.prompt: A Type III curve has p = 8 and gamma = 1. What are the memoir skewness and mu4/mu2^2?
self_checks.answer: The memoir skewness is 1/3 and mu4/mu2^2 is 11/3.

overview_sentence: A [Pearson distribution](articles/pearson-distribution.qmd) is a frequency curve whose slope at the mode has a quadratic denominator.
